name: ai-ready-project
description: ShiftOS Session 6 companion. Install, then run the /ai-ready slash command to take one real workflow through the AI-Ready Method — seven moves that turn a fuzzy project into one your agents can run with autonomy. Produces three artifacts in your project folder: the project brief (saved as the project's CLAUDE.md), a first draft of your deliverable, and a session debrief in the project's memory. Re-run the command inside the same project anytime to cold-test the brief or tighten it after real use.
